methodology.UserFees: User pays dynamic fees on each swap based on pool settings (typically 0.01% to 1%).
methodology.Fees: Dynamic fees are collected on each swap based on pool configuration
methodology.Revenue: Protocol takes 13.23% of collected fees (current). Historical: 8.5% before March 2025; 10% on uni forks like IMX.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Foundation receives 30% of the protocol revenue since Nov 4, 2025 (~3.97% of fees). Before that ~3.23% of fees; 3% on uni forks.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Community receives 70% of the protocol revenue since Nov 4, 2025 (~9.26% of fees) for buybacks. Before that 10% of fees; 7% on uni forks.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: ~86.77% of collected fees go to liquidity providers (90% on uni forks like IMX).

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders only. External bribes are deposited by third parties to influence votes, so they are excluded here even though they count towards Fees.
methodology.Fees: Per-pool swap fee read from PoolFactory.getFee (default vAMM 0.30% / sAMM 0.05%, customizable per pool) applied to each swap, plus external bribes deposited by third parties to voter-incentive contracts.
methodology.Revenue: veVELO voters’ take: staked-LP swap fees forwarded to voters plus external bribes. Equals HoldersRevenue — Velodrome keeps no treasury cut of swap fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Swap fees from staked LPs (fee × pool.balanceOf(gauge) / pool.totalSupply), forwarded to veVELO voters, plus external bribes.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees kept by unstaked LPs (fee × (1 − stakedShare)). LPs who stake in the gauge forgo these fees in exchange for VELO emissions.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume across Velodrome v2 (non-CL) pools, counted once per swap from the core-asset side.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, per-pool rate from PoolFactory.getFee applied to each swap amount.
Fees.External Bribes Rewards: External incentives deposited by third parties to the voter bribe/incentive contracts (NotifyReward events).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, per-pool rate from PoolFactory.getFee applied to each swap amount.

Revenue.Staked-LP Swap Fees: Staked-LP share of swap fees, forwarded to veVELO voters.
Revenue.External Bribes Revenue: External incentives deposited by third parties, claimable by veVELO voters.

HoldersRevenue.Staked-LP Swap Fees: Staked-LP share of swap fees, forwarded to veVELO voters.
HoldersRevenue.External Bribes Revenue: External incentives deposited by third parties, claimable by veVELO voters.

SupplySideRevenue.Unstaked-LP Swap Fees: Unstaked-LP share of swap fees, claimable directly from the pool.

methodology.Fees: Total swap fees paid by users.
methodology.Revenue: The share of swap fees that goes to veVELO voters: everything earned by liquidity staked in a gauge, plus the rake taken from unstaked liquidity.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of swap fees that goes to veVELO voters: everything earned by liquidity staked in a gauge, plus the rake taken from unstaked liquidity.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The share of swap fees kept by liquidity providers who have not staked their position in a gauge, after the rake.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Total swap fees paid by users.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Voters: Fees earned by gauge-staked liquidity plus the rake on unstaked liquidity, both claimable by voters.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To Voters: Fees earned by gauge-staked liquidity plus the rake on unstaked liquidity, both claimable by voters.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Unstaked LPs: Fees earned by liquidity that is not staked in a gauge, net of the rake, which stays with the position owner.

methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders

methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

methodology.Revenue: Fee switch enabled on 27 Jul 2026 (tracked in uniswap-v3 adapter), a part of fees collected to buy back and burn UNI.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fee switch enabled on 27 Jul 2026 (tracked in uniswap-v3 adapter), a part of fees collected to buy back and burn UNI.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Part of fees distributed to LPs after protocol cut. (It was 100% of fees before fee switch(27 Jul 2026)).
methodology.Volume: Swap volume, excluding wash trading: pools whose daily trades come from too few distinct addresses to be organic, unless every pool token is a core asset or CoinGecko-listed.

methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders

methodology.HoldersRevenue: Community receives 70% of the protocol revenue since Nov 4, 2025 (before that 10% of fees) for buybacks.
